title: Dataknobs Capabilities For Enterprises
description: Dataknobs Capabilities for building Dataproducts right from start. It focus on building Data Assets and Serving these assets to customers. KREATE is key capability that help in creating data assets as well as creating software (Web apps, Web Assistant, API) to serve these to customer. KONTROL focus on guardrails and governance. KNOBS have capabilities related to diagnostic and experimentation.
